name: Rerun
summary: No-code team of AI coworkers that run recurring business tasks 24/7, with human approval and a private cloud machine.
description: Rerun lets you install no-code “Coworkers” that run around the clock on a private cloud machine for each workspace—chasing invoices, qualifying leads or clearing an inbox—while you watch every step and they pause before sensitive actions. You can use the included models, connect your own API key, or plug in an existing ChatGPT or Claude subscription. Enterprise is custom.
features: real-time step view and approval gates
